svg.text: Exact standard-cell topology from counter_mapped.v | 10 logic cells + 8 latches
clk low: master tracks next-state; clk high: slave tracks master. All 8 gate pins use the same clk net.
rst_n low: next-state = 0. Otherwise: en high increments modulo 16; en low holds. Reset acts through data logic.
Identical labels are electrically connected. count[i] is the slave[i] alias in the Yosys netlist.
All standard cells: VPWR / VPB -> VPWR, VGND / VNB -> VGND. Supply connections are symbol attributes.
Source: ../counter_mapped.v | Library: sky130_fd_sc_hd | Native xschem schematic
